title: GCP DevOps Manager – Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

DevOps Manager – Google Cloud Platform (GCP)

Role Summary

We are looking for a DevOps Manager to own the reliability, observability, and cost

efficiency of our applications on Google Cloud Platform. The role covers end-to-end

responsibility for application usage monitoring, cloud cost management (FinOps), CI/CD

pipeline setup and governance, centralized logging, and billing oversight. You will lead a

team of DevOps/Cloud engineers and work closely with application development, security,

and infrastructure teams.

Key Responsibilities

1. Application & Usage Monitoring

* Design and implement monitoring for application health, performance, and usage using

Google Cloud Monitoring, Prometheus/Grafana, or equivalent tools.

* Define and track SLIs/SLOs, uptime, latency, error rates, and capacity utilization across

environments.

* Build dashboards for application usage trends (API call volumes, transaction

throughput, active users) for engineering and business stakeholders.

* Set up proactive alerting (Cloud Monitoring alerts, PagerDuty/Opsgenie integration) and

drive reduction of alert noise.

* Conduct capacity planning and performance reviews based on usage data.

2. Cloud Cost Management & FinOps

* Own GCP cost visibility: set up cost dashboards by project, service, environment, and

team using GCP Billing reports, BigQuery billing export, and Looker Studio.

* Implement labeling/tagging standards for accurate cost attribution and

chargeback/showback.

* Identify and drive cost-optimization initiatives: rightsizing VMs/GKE nodes, committed

use discounts (CUDs), spot/preemptible instances, storage lifecycle policies, and idleresource

cleanup.

* Set up budgets, alerts, and quotas to prevent cost overruns; publish monthly cost

review reports with variance analysis.

* Forecast cloud spend and support annual budgeting for cloud infrastructure.

3. CI/CD Setup & Governance

* Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Cloud Build, GitHub Actions, GitLab

CI, or Jenkins, deploying to GKE, Cloud Run, App Engine, or Compute Engine.

* Standardize build, test, security-scan, and deployment stages across teams

(SAST/DAST, container image scanning, artifact management via Artifact Registry).

* Implement deployment strategies: blue-green, canary, and rollback automation.
* Enforce Infrastructure as Code (Terraform preferred) with code review and drift

detection.

* Manage environment promotion workflows (Dev → QA → UAT → Prod) with appropriate

approvals and audit trails.

4. Logging & Observability Setup

* Architect centralized logging using Cloud Logging with log sinks, routing, retention

policies, and export to BigQuery/Cloud Storage for long-term analysis.

* Define structured logging standards for application teams and ensure adoption.
* Set up log-based metrics and alerts for security and operational events.
* Ensure log retention and access controls meet compliance and audit requirements.
* Integrate logs with SIEM tooling where required.

5. Billing Administration

* Administer GCP billing accounts, projects, and IAM around billing (Billing Admin/Viewer

roles).

* Reconcile monthly GCP invoices against usage; coordinate with Finance on accruals and

payments.

* Manage billing account hierarchy, project-to-billing mapping, and sub-account

structures for multiple business units.

* Liaise with Google/partner account teams on pricing, credits, CUD purchases, and

support plans.

6. Team Leadership & Governance

* Lead, mentor, and grow a team of DevOps/Cloud engineers; manage on-call rotations

and incident response processes.

* Define runbooks, SOPs, and DR/backup procedures; drive post-incident reviews (RCA)

with corrective actions.

* Partner with Security/InfoSec on IAM hygiene, VPC/network controls, and audit

readiness.

* Report DevOps KPIs (deployment frequency, lead time, MTTR, change failure rate, cost

per transaction) to leadership.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent.
* 4+ years of hands-on GCP experience: GKE, Compute Engine, Cloud Run, Cloud Build,

Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Logging, IAM, VPC, and BigQuery (billing export/analysis).

* Strong experience with CI/CD tooling (Cloud Build, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or GitHub

Actions) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes/GKE).

* Proven track record in cloud cost optimization / FinOps practices on GCP.
* Infrastructure as Code expertise — Terraform strongly preferred.
* Scripting proficiency: Python, Bash, or Go.
* Experience setting up centralized logging, monitoring, and alerting at scale.
* Experience managing GCP billing accounts and working with Finance teams.
* 2+ years leading or mentoring a DevOps/SRE team.

Preferred / Good to Have

* GCP certifications: Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer, Professional Cloud Architect, or

FinOps Certified Practitioner.

* Experience in regulated environments (BFSI/GovTech) with audit, compliance, and

data-residency requirements.

* Exposure to multi-cloud or hybrid setups.
* Familiarity with service mesh (Istio/Anthos Service Mesh), secrets management (Secret

Manager/Vault), and policy-as-code (OPA).

* Experience with SIEM integration and security monitoring.

Key Performance Indicators (First 12 Months)

* 99.9%+ availability against defined SLOs for critical applications.
* 15–20% reduction in GCP spend through optimization initiatives (baseline-dependent).
* CI/CD pipelines standardized across all active product teams with < 1 day lead time for

changes.

* Centralized logging live for all production workloads with compliant retention.
* Monthly cost and usage reporting operational with < 5% unexplained invoice variance.

Pay: ₹1,500,000.00 - ₹2,000,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: 4748 - Site Reliability Engineer II
description:
**About the Role**

We at Innovaccer are looking for a **Site Reliability Engineer-II** to build secured modern healthcare cloud infrastructure and a massive data stack and aim to write everything as code

**A Day in the Life**

* Take ownership of SRE pillars: Deployment, Reliability, Scalability, Service Availability (SLA/SLO/SLI), Performance, and Cost.
* Lead production rollouts of new releases and emergency patches using CI/CD pipelines while continuously improving deployment processes.
* Establish robust production promotion and change management processes with quality gates across Dev/QA teams.
* Roll out a complete observability stack across systems to proactively detect and resolve outages or degradations.
* Analyze production system metrics, optimize system utilization, and drive cost efficiency.
* Manage autoscaling of the platform during peak usage scenarios.
* Perform triage and RCA by leveraging observability toolchains across the platform architecture.
* Reduce escalations to higher-level teams through proactive reliability improvements.
* Participate in the 24x7 On Call Production Support team.
* Lead monthly operational reviews with executives covering KPIs such as uptime, RCA, CAP (Corrective Action Plan), PAP (Preventive Action Plan), and security/audit reports.
* Operate and manage production and staging cloud platforms, ensuring uptime and SLA adherence.
* Collaborate with Dev, QA, DevOps, and Customer Success teams to drive RCA and product improvements.
* Implement security guidelines (e.g., DDoS protection, vulnerability management, patch management, security agents).
* Manage least-privilege RBAC for production services and toolchains

**What You Need**

* 4–7 years in production engineering, site reliability, or related roles.
* Solid hands-on experience with at least 2 cloud provider (AWS, Azure, GCP) with automation focus (certifications preferred).
* Strong expertise in Kubernetes and Linux.
* Proficiency in scripting/programming (Python required).
* Observability is very critical for the scale of our systems and ability to find insights/behavior, detect problem/failures. Looking for leads to drive this charter spanning across logs, metrics, mesh, tracing etc.
* Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and toolchains (Jenkins, ArgoCD, GitOps).
* Familiarity with persistence stores (Postgres, MongoDB), data warehousing (Snowflake, Databricks), and messaging (Kafka).
* Exposure to monitoring/observability tools such as ElasticSearch, Prometheus, Jaeger, NewRelic, etc.
* Proven experience in production reliability, scalability, and performance systems.
* Experience in 24x7 production environments with process focus.
* Familiarity with ticketing and incident management systems.
* Security-first mindset with knowledge of vulnerability management and compliance.
* Advantageous: hands-on experience with Kafka, Postgres, and Snowflake.
* Lead least privilege based RBAC for various production services and tool chains.

title: DevOps Engineering Manager
description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**

At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe**  
Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.

In management at Crowe, you play a pivotal role in leading teams, guiding project execution, and deepening client relationships. You are expected to contribute to account planning, identify opportunities to add value, and ensure high-quality delivery. As your responsibilities expand, you take on broader account ownership, balancing project leadership with growing involvement in client strategy and solution development.

Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.

**Role Summary**

The Manager, DevOps Engineering is the lead hands-on engineer responsible for the India-based DevOps capability supporting enterprise applications, integrations, data platforms, and cloud infrastructure. The role combines technical leadership with direct engineering accountability across Azure infrastructure, networking, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, security, environment management, observability, and production readiness.

This is not a process-focused or administrative management role. The manager is expected to personally design, build, review, and troubleshoot infrastructure, deployment pipelines, network configurations, access controls, monitoring, and automation. The role will also establish engineering standards, mentor DevOps engineers, review technical work, and serve as the escalation point for complex infrastructure and deployment issues.

The manager will work closely with enterprise architects, application teams, integration engineers, data engineers, networking, security, and delivery leadership to ensure environments and deployment processes are secure, repeatable, scalable, and operationally supportable. The role is accountable for improving delivery discipline, reducing manual processes, resolving environment bottlenecks, and ensuring infrastructure and releases are ready for production.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and mentor DevOps engineers while remaining hands-on in delivery.
* Design and support Azure infrastructure, networking, identity, monitoring, and platform services.
* Manage virtual networks, subnets, private endpoints, DNS, routing, firewalls, and IP capacity.
* Build and maintain reusable Infrastructure as Code using Bicep or Terraform.
* Design and support Azure DevOps YAML pipelines and reusable deployment templates.
* Automate environment provisioning, configuration, testing, release, rollback, and recovery.
* Implement Microsoft Entra ID, managed identities, service principals, RBAC, Key Vault, and least-privilege controls.
* Establish monitoring, logging, alerting, dashboards, and operational runbooks.
* Review infrastructure code, pipeline code, scripts, and security changes.
* Lead troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, incident response, and production-readiness reviews.
* Enforce DevOps, security, release, and operational engineering standards.
* Partner with architecture, application, integration, data, networking, and security teams.

**Required Qualifications**

* 8+ years of DevOps, cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, or related experience.
* 4+ years of hands-on Microsoft Azure engineering experience.
* 2+ years in a lead engineer or technical management role.
* Strong Azure networking and IP-address planning experience.
* Strong Infrastructure as Code experience using Bicep, Terraform, or both.
* Strong Azure DevOps and YAML pipeline experience.
* Experience with Microsoft Entra ID, RBAC, managed identities, service principals, and Key Vault.
* Experience with Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Application Insights.
* Strong scripting skills using PowerShell, Azure CLI, Bash, or Python.
* Demonstrated ability to lead engineers while remaining technically hands-on.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting Azure Functions, API Management, Service Bus, Event Grid, Event Hubs, and microservices.
* Experience with D365 Finance and Operations, Power Platform, or Dataverse.
* Experience with Azure Policy, security scanning, disaster recovery, and cost optimization.
* Experience with containers, AKS, or site reliability engineering practices.

We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.
